title: Sight Reader
description: Practise reading music: name each note of a score as a cursor reaches it.

actions.title: Open a Score in Sight Reader
actions.description: Open one of the site's sample scores in Sight Reader for the person at the page. The path is relative to the sample scores, such as simple/Frere Jacques.musicxml, and the site's /content/scores/index.json lists them.
